nodes.summary: There is a compact set $K \subseteq \mathbb{R}^2$ of Lebesgue measure zero that contains a unit segment in every direction: $K$ is measurable, and for every unit vector $v \in \mathbb{R}^2$ there is a point $a \in \mathbb{R}^2$ with $a + t v \in K$ for all $t \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Besicovitch's Kakeya set of measure zero

nodes.summary: A Kakeya set is a compact subset $K$ of three-dimensional Euclidean space that contains a unit line segment in every direction: for every unit vector $v$ there is a point $x$ with $x + t v \in K$ for all $t \in [0, 1]$.
nodes.title: Kakeya set

nodes.summary: The space $\mathbb{R}^3$ with the Euclidean inner product.
nodes.title: Three-dimensional Euclidean space

nodes.summary: Every Kakeya set in three-dimensional Euclidean space has Hausdorff dimension $3$.
nodes.title: Wang–Zahl theorem: the Kakeya conjecture in three dimensions
